data.name: 24K Cleopatra Regime facial Treatment
data.description:
Short Description 
None

What It Does & Benefits
Removes impurities: The treatment cleanses and exfoliates the skin, removing dead skin cells, dirt, and excess oils.
Stimulates collagen production: 24K gold encourages collagen synthesis, improving skin elasticity and reducing fine lines and wrinkles.
Improves skin texture: Provides smoother, softer, and more even skin tone.
Hydrates and nourishes: Deeply hydrates the skin, leaving it plump, moisturized, and rejuvenated.
Brightens and evens complexion: The treatment works to enhance skin radiance and promote a more even skin tone.
Anti-inflammatory effects: Gold particles in the treatment have anti-inflammatory properties, soothing irritated skin.

Instructions
Cleanse: Begin with a deep cleanse to remove makeup, dirt, and impurities from the skin.
Exfoliate: Apply an exfoliating scrub or mask to slough off dead skin cells and prepare the skin for better absorption of the active ingredients.
Apply 24K Gold Serum: Gently massage a serum infused with 24K gold into the skin to stimulate collagen production and increase skin elasticity.
Facial Massage: Use upward strokes to massage the product into the skin, promoting relaxation, circulation, and better product absorption.
Hydrating Mask: Apply a hydrating mask to nourish and lock in moisture. Leave on for 10-15 minutes.
Finishing Serum and Moisturizer: Follow up with a finishing serum and moisturizer to seal in hydration and provide long-lasting results.
Sunscreen (if daytime): Apply sunscreen to protect the skin from UV damage and maintain the benefits of the treatment.

Active Ingredients
24K Gold: Enhances collagen production, reduces signs of aging, and promotes a glowing complexion.
Hyaluronic Acid: Provides deep hydration, plumping the skin and smoothing fine lines.
Vitamin C: Brightens the skin and reduces dark spots while offering antioxidant protection.
Peptides: Help in restoring skin elasticity and reducing wrinkles.
Aloe Vera: Soothes and calms the skin, reducing redness and inflammation.
Retinol: Stimulates skin renewal, reducing fine lines and improving skin texture.

Skin Type
Suitable for all skin types, especially mature, dry, and sensitive skin. Ideal for individuals seeking anti-aging benefits, hydration, and a radiant complexion.

data.name: 30 min Cleanse, Serum, Hydrate & LED
data.description:
Short Description
The 30-Minute Cleanse Facial Treatment is a quick, effective skincare procedure designed to deeply cleanse the skin, removing impurities and excess oils while refreshing and rejuvenating the complexion. Ideal for busy schedules, this treatment focuses on cleansing, exfoliating, and hydrating the skin in a short amount of time to leave the skin feeling clean, smooth, and refreshed.

What It Does & Benefits
Removes impurities: Effectively cleanses the skin by removing dirt, oil, and makeup, leaving it fresh and balanced.
Unclogs pores: Exfoliates the skin gently, clearing blocked pores and preventing breakouts.
Hydrates and nourishes: Restores moisture to the skin, keeping it soft and hydrated.
Improves skin texture: Gently smooths and refines the skin's surface for a brighter and more even complexion.
Refreshes and energizes: Provides an instant refreshing boost, leaving the skin feeling invigorated.

Instructions
Cleanse: Start by applying a gentle cleanser to the face to remove surface dirt and makeup. Use lukewarm water and a soft cloth or your hands.
Exfoliate: Apply an exfoliating scrub or enzyme treatment to remove dead skin cells and clear pores. Massage gently in circular motions for 1-2 minutes.
Mask (optional): If desired, apply a hydrating or purifying mask and leave on for 5-10 minutes, depending on the type of mask.
Tone: Apply a toner to balance the skin’s pH levels and prepare it for hydration.
Moisturize: Follow with a hydrating moisturizer to lock in moisture and ensure soft, smooth skin.
Sunscreen (if daytime): Apply sunscreen to protect the skin from UV damage after the treatment.

Active Ingredients
Hyaluronic Acid: Hydrates and plumps the skin, maintaining moisture balance.
Salicylic Acid: Gently exfoliates and clears pores, ideal for oily or acne-prone skin.
Aloe Vera: Soothes and calms the skin, reducing irritation and redness.
Vitamin C: Brightens the skin and provides antioxidant protection.
Glycerin: Helps retain moisture, ensuring a smooth and hydrated feel.
Green Tea Extract: Calms the skin and provides anti-inflammatory benefits.

Skin Type
Suitable for all skin types, especially oily, combination, and sensitive skin. This treatment is gentle enough for sensitive skin but effective at clearing impurities and refreshing the complexion.

data.name: Cold Plasma
data.description:
Short Description
Cold Plasma is a high-tech skincare treatment that uses low-temperature, ionized gas (plasma) to improve skin health. This treatment is designed to stimulate skin cells, promote healing, and enhance the absorption of other active ingredients in skincare products. The technology can be used for a variety of skin concerns, including signs of aging, inflammation, and uneven texture.

What It Does & Benefits
Improves Skin Texture: Helps smooth the skin by promoting collagen production and increasing cell turnover.
Reduces Fine Lines & Wrinkles: Stimulates the skin’s natural repair process, which can reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.
Balances Skin Tone: Helps even out skin tone and texture by targeting pigmentation and boosting the skin’s regeneration process.
Hydrates & Firms Skin: Boosts skin hydration and can improve firmness and elasticity by enhancing the absorption of moisture.
Soothes & Calms the Skin: The cold plasma technology has anti-inflammatory properties, making it beneficial for those with sensitive or irritated skin.

Instructions
Cleanse the Skin: Start with a clean face by removing makeup, dirt, and oils.
Apply Serum (Optional): If using with a serum, apply it to your face before the Cold Plasma device for enhanced absorption.
Cold Plasma Application: Using a Cold Plasma device or facial treatment, apply the cold plasma to the skin. This process is painless, and you will typically feel a cool sensation.
Post-Treatment Care: After the treatment, apply a gentle moisturizer and sunscreen. If using at home, follow the device instructions for the recommended frequency and usage.

Active Ingredients
Ionized Gas (Plasma): The primary component in Cold Plasma treatment, which is electrically charged and helps to stimulate the skin at a cellular level.
Hyaluronic Acid: Often paired with Cold Plasma, this ingredient helps to deeply hydrate the skin and plump the complexion.
Peptides: Assist in stimulating collagen production, improving skin strength and elasticity.
Vitamin C & E: Provide antioxidant protection and help to brighten the skin.

Skin Type
Cold Plasma is suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin, due to its gentle yet effective nature. It is particularly beneficial for individuals with: Aging skin (fine lines, wrinkles), Dull, uneven skin tone Dry or dehydrated skin, Sensitive or irritated skin

data.name: Collagen Boosting Microneedling  Facial
data.description:
Short Description
The Collagen Boosting Microneedling Facial uses tiny needles to create controlled micro-injuries in the skin, stimulating collagen production. This non-invasive treatment improves skin texture, reduces fine lines and acne scars, and enhances skin elasticity, leaving you with smoother, firmer, and more youthful-looking skin.

What It Does & Benefits
Collagen Boosting Microneedling Facial stimulates collagen production by creating tiny controlled micro-injuries in the skin. This process promotes natural healing, improving skin texture, tone, and elasticity. The treatment targets fine lines, wrinkles, acne scars, hyperpigmentation, and enlarged pores, leaving skin smoother, firmer, and more youthful.

Instructions
Cleanse the skin thoroughly before starting the procedure.
Apply a numbing cream to minimize discomfort during the treatment.
Use a microneedling device with fine needles to create micro-injuries in the skin’s surface.
Apply a serum or treatment to further enhance the healing process and promote collagen production.
After the session, allow the skin to recover naturally.
Post-Treatment Care:
Avoid sun exposure for 48 hours and always apply sunscreen.
Refrain from using harsh skincare products (such as retinol) for a few days.
Keep the skin hydrated and avoid touching or picking at the treated area.
Expect mild redness or swelling, which typically subsides within a few hours to a day.

Active Ingredients
Hyaluronic Acid: For deep hydration.
Vitamin C: For brightening and antioxidant protection.
Peptides: To support collagen and elastin production.

Skin Type
None

data.name: Express Hydrodemabration
data.description:
Short Description
The Express Hydrodermabrasion Facial is a quick, non-invasive treatment that exfoliates, hydrates, and rejuvenates the skin. Using water-based technology, it removes dead skin cells, unclogs pores, and infuses nourishing serums, leaving the skin refreshed, smooth, and glowing in just 30 minutes.

What It Does & Benefits
The Express Hydrodermabrasion Facial is a non-invasive skin treatment that combines exfoliation, hydration, and deep cleansing. It uses water-based technology to remove dead skin cells, unclog pores, and infuse the skin with nourishing serums. This treatment is ideal for those seeking glowing, smooth, and refreshed skin with minimal downtime.

Instructions
Cleanse the skin thoroughly to remove makeup and impurities.
Use the hydrodermabrasion device, which sprays a fine mist of water and serum onto the skin, while simultaneously removing dead skin cells.
The process includes gentle suction to remove debris and promote circulation.
A serum (often containing antioxidants, peptides, or hyaluronic acid) is infused into the skin for added nourishment and hydration.
Post-Treatment Care:
Keep the skin moisturized and avoid heavy makeup for the first 24 hours.
Apply sunscreen daily, as the skin can be more sensitive to the sun.
Avoid exfoliating or using harsh products for a few days after the treatment.

Active Ingredients
Hyaluronic Acid: Hydrates and plumps the skin.
Vitamin C: Brightens and provides antioxidant protection.
Peptides: Promote skin repair and improve texture.

Skin Type
None

data.name: Full Face - RF Microneedling
data.description:
Short Description
Full Face RF Microneedling combines traditional microneedling with radiofrequency energy to stimulate collagen production and tighten the skin. This non-invasive treatment targets wrinkles, fine lines, and uneven texture, leaving the skin smoother, firmer, and more youthful-looking with minimal downtime. 

What It Does & Benefits
Full Face RF (Radio Frequency) Microneedling is a skin rejuvenation treatment that combines the benefits of traditional microneedling with the added power of radiofrequency energy. The treatment uses tiny needles to create micro-injuries in the skin while delivering heat through radiofrequency, stimulating collagen production and tightening the skin. It helps improve the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles, acne scars, enlarged pores, and uneven skin texture, resulting in smoother, firmer, and more youthful-looking skin.

Instructions
Cleanse the skin thoroughly to remove makeup and impurities.
Apply a numbing cream to minimize discomfort during the treatment.
Use a microneedling device with fine needles to create microchannels in the skin.
During the treatment, radiofrequency energy is delivered to the dermis layer, further stimulating collagen production and skin tightening.
A calming serum is often applied after the treatment to promote healing.
Post-Treatment Care:
Mild redness and swelling may occur for up to 24-48 hours.
Avoid sun exposure and apply sunscreen regularly.
Avoid using retinols, exfoliants, or harsh skincare products for a few days after treatment.
Keep the skin hydrated and refrain from picking or touching the treated area.
It is recommended to avoid makeup for at least 24 hours after the procedure.

Active Ingredients
Hyaluronic Acid: For deep hydration and plumping effects.
Vitamin C: For brightening and antioxidant protection.
Peptides: To support collagen production and skin repair.

Skin Type
None

data.name: Hifu - Neck Only
data.description:
Short Description
HIFU for the neck is a non-invasive ultrasound treatment designed to tighten and lift sagging skin, reducing fine lines and wrinkles. It stimulates collagen production, enhancing the neck’s appearance and providing a youthful, firm look without surgery.

What It Does & Benefits
HIFU (High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound) penetrates deep into the skin to stimulate collagen and elastin production, helping to tighten and lift the neck area. It’s effective for reducing sagging, smoothing wrinkles, and improving overall skin texture. The treatment provides long-lasting results with minimal downtime and no need for invasive procedures.

Instructions
Cleanse the neck area to remove any oils or makeup.
Apply a conductive gel to facilitate the ultrasound energy.
The HIFU device is moved across the neck, delivering focused ultrasound energy to target deeper layers of the skin.
The procedure typically takes 30-45 minutes, depending on the individual’s needs.
After treatment, a soothing serum may be applied to calm the skin.

Active Ingredients
No topical active ingredients are required for the HIFU procedure itself, but soothing post-treatment serums may include:
Hyaluronic Acid: For hydration and soothing.
Peptides: To support skin healing and collagen repair.

Skin Type
HIFU is suitable for most skin types, especially those with mild to moderate sagging or signs of aging on the neck. It works well for individuals looking for non-invasive skin tightening and rejuvenation. It’s ideal for those with aging skin or individuals in their 30s to 60s seeking preventive or corrective treatment for the neck area.

data.name: Hifu Chin Neck Treatment Offer
data.description:
Short Description
The HIFU Chin & Neck Treatment is a non-invasive procedure that uses focused ultrasound energy to lift and tighten the skin on the chin and neck. It stimulates collagen production for a more defined jawline and smoother, firmer skin.

What It Does & Benefits
HIFU (High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound) targets deeper layers of the skin to promote collagen and elastin production. This results in skin tightening and lifting around the chin and neck area, reducing sagging, fine lines, and wrinkles. It provides a more contoured, youthful appearance without surgery or downtime.

Instructions
Cleanse the chin and neck area to remove oils or makeup.
Apply a conductive gel to enhance ultrasound penetration.
The HIFU device is used to deliver focused ultrasound energy to the skin, targeting deeper layers for tightening and lifting.
The procedure takes about 30-45 minutes, depending on the area treated.
Post-treatment, a soothing serum may be applied to calm the skin.

Active Ingredients
No topical active ingredients are used during the HIFU treatment, but post-care serums may contain:
Hyaluronic Acid: For hydration and soothing.
Peptides: To promote skin healing and collagen production.

Skin Type
HIFU is suitable for most skin types, particularly for individuals experiencing sagging or aging signs in the chin and neck area. It’s ideal for those seeking a non-surgical solution to improve skin laxity and rejuvenate the neck and jawline. Best for individuals in their 30s to 60s looking for preventive or corrective treatment.

data.name: Hifu Eye Lifting Treatment Offer
data.description:
Short Description
The HIFU Eye Lifting Treatment is a non-invasive procedure that uses high-intensity focused ultrasound to tighten and lift the delicate skin around the eyes. This treatment reduces the appearance of sagging eyelids, fine lines, and puffiness, providing a refreshed, more youthful eye contour.

What It Does & Benefits
HIFU (High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound) stimulates collagen production in the deeper layers of the skin around the eyes, helping to lift and tighten sagging skin. It improves the appearance of crow's feet, under-eye bags, and drooping eyelids, offering a non-surgical solution for a more rejuvenated eye area with minimal downtime.

Instructions
Cleanse the eye area thoroughly to remove any makeup or impurities.
Apply a conductive gel to the skin to facilitate ultrasound energy penetration.
The HIFU device is gently moved around the eye area, delivering focused ultrasound energy to the skin, promoting collagen production.
The procedure lasts about 30-45 minutes, depending on the individual’s needs.
Post-treatment, a soothing serum may be applied to calm the area.

Active Ingredients
No topical active ingredients are required during the HIFU procedure, but soothing serums may include:
Hyaluronic Acid: To hydrate and plump the skin.
Peptides: To support skin repair and collagen regeneration.

Skin Type
HIFU for the eyes is suitable for most skin types, particularly individuals with early to moderate signs of aging, such as sagging eyelids or fine lines around the eyes. Ideal for those seeking a non-invasive, effective solution for a youthful, refreshed eye appearance without surgery.

data.name: Hifu Liftera Chin & Neck
data.description:
Short Description
The HIFU Liftera Chin & Neck treatment is a non-invasive procedure using high-intensity focused ultrasound to lift, tighten, and contour the chin and neck area. This treatment reduces sagging, defines the jawline, and smooths wrinkles, offering a more youthful, sculpted appearance without the need for surgery.

What It Does & Benefits
HIFU Liftera stimulates deep layers of the skin with ultrasound energy to promote collagen and elastin production. It tightens and firms the skin, helping to reduce sagging and create a more defined chin and neck contour. This treatment smooths fine lines, tightens loose skin, and improves overall texture, providing natural-looking results without downtime.

Instructions
Cleanse the chin and neck area to remove any oils, makeup, or impurities.
Apply a conductive gel to the skin to optimize ultrasound energy penetration.
The HIFU Liftera device is moved across the chin and neck area, delivering ultrasound energy to stimulate collagen production and lift the skin.
The procedure typically takes 30-45 minutes, depending on the areas treated.
After treatment, a soothing serum may be applied to calm the skin.

Active Ingredients
No specific topical active ingredients are used during the HIFU treatment itself, but soothing post-treatment serums may contain:
Hyaluronic Acid: To hydrate and soothe the skin.
Peptides: To enhance skin healing and collagen production.

Skin Type
HIFU Liftera Chin & Neck is suitable for most skin types, particularly those experiencing sagging skin or signs of aging in the chin and neck area. It is ideal for individuals looking for non-surgical skin tightening, contouring, and rejuvenation, typically for those in their 30s to 60s.

data.name: HydraLift Express
data.description:
Short Description
The HydraLift Express is a fast and effective facial treatment that combines hydration, exfoliation, and skin lifting. It uses advanced technology to deeply cleanse the skin, infuse moisture, and lift the skin for an instantly refreshed, glowing, and youthful appearance in just a short amount of time.

What It Does & Benefits
The HydraLift Express treatment delivers deep hydration while gently exfoliating dead skin cells and impurities. It stimulates collagen production, providing a lifting effect that reduces fine lines and enhances skin elasticity. The skin looks smoother, plumper, and more youthful with a noticeable glow. It’s perfect for a quick skin refresh before an event or to maintain healthy, radiant skin.

Instructions
Cleanse the skin to remove makeup and impurities.
The HydraLift device is used to exfoliate the skin gently, removing dead cells and debris.
A hydrating serum is infused into the skin to provide moisture and nourishment.
The treatment also uses gentle lifting technology to firm the skin.
The procedure typically takes about 30 minutes, and the skin may feel refreshed immediately afterward.

Active Ingredients
Hyaluronic Acid: Deeply hydrates and plumps the skin.
Vitamin C: Brightens the complexion and offers antioxidant protection.
Peptides: Promote skin rejuvenation, improve elasticity, and enhance skin texture.

Skin Type
The HydraLift Express is suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. It is especially beneficial for individuals looking to hydrate and rejuvenate their skin, reduce fine lines, and improve overall skin tone and texture. Ideal for those with dry, dull, or aging skin.
